How To Fill MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025

Interested candidates who wish to Fill for the MUIT post can submit their application online before 15 July 2025. Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly. Alternatively, visit the official website of MUIT to complete the application process online. Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 15 July 2025 .
MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025 While Form Filling Documents Required
A passport-sized color photograph (scanned). The background should be white or light-colored.
Scanned signature on a white background. Should be done using a black or blue pen.
Must have completed their 10+2 (Intermediate) or High School level exam, with English and Hindi as compulsory subjects. For More Details Read Notification

For candidates applying under Rajasthan state domicile.
For candidates applying under the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category.

Aadhaar card, voter ID, or any other government-issued ID for identity verification.

Question: When will the online application for MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025 start? Answer: The online application for this exam Has Started On 24 March 2025.
Question: What is the last date for MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025 ? Answer: The last date to apply online for this exam is 15 July 2025.

Question: What is the age limit for MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025 ? Answer: The age limit for candidates applying for this exam is as per the MUIT Admissions rules. For detailed age-related information, refer to the official notification.

Question: What is the eligibility for MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025 ? Answer: Candidates must have passed 12th (Science) with Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects along with Mathematics or Biology , OR 12th (Science) with Mathematics , OR 12th (Science) with a Vocational/Technical subject , OR 10th + ITI .

MUIT Admissions Online Form 2025

Post Date: March 26, 2025

3:46 pm

Maharishi University MUIT Lucknow and Noida Campus, The official website has released a notification for the admission to the UG, PG and Diploma Courses Admissions 2025. The MUIT application form started on 24th March 2025, and candidates can fill out the form until 15th July 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for the MUIT Admissions online form 2025, which are given below.
